lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Hello, Gym Rat!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: In case you don't recognize this number,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: it's Rumani, from Body X Body Gym.
Hey, Rumani. Nice to talk to you.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Likewise!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'm really excited at the thought of

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: being able to manage your progress

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: more closely and frequently.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Just thinking about it is making my muscles tingle! ^.^
I think what you've done is enough for now...

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: We were only in a trainer-member relationship before,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: so all I could give were a few simple tips.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: But now that we're officially a team,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll be able to give you proper personal training sessions.
Is that really necessary?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: 100%! It's my job to keep everyone in top shape!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Tell me,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: have you been sitting a lot for work lately?
Yeah, a bit.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I couldn't help but notice your posture has worsened somewhat,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and your shoulders seem a bit rounded as well.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I think starting with posture correction would be a good idea.
Oh, really?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I've also noticed that you don't stretch before your workouts.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Lifting weights and working up a sweat is all well and good, but

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: stretching before your workout is absolutely essential.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Skipping this step could lead to muscle injuries

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: or even posture issues.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll show you a 20-minute stretching routine you can do before and after your workouts.
No, wait.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: It seems like when you work out, you don't really have a set plan

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and just go with what you feel like at the time.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: From now on, I'll create a detailed plan for you.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll analyze which of your muscle groups are weaker

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and where you have the most excess fat.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You'll love it,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'm sure of it!
The only thing is that I'll be pretty busy for a while...

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: That's why I'll also be preparing a home workout routine for you.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll even come over and help you with your training.
Er... Don't you think we're going a bit overboard with all this?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: It's important to establish these habits early on, so things will get easier later.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Don't worry,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll be there to help you along the way.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You don't have any plans for today, right?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll see you at the gym later.
Hold on...
Rumani doesn't respond.
I can feel it in my bones that a hellish training regime is about to begin.
